title: Fault Forest Navigator — multi-variant error browsing and payload diff panel
creator: Aisha Campbell
description: Design a compact, scannable Console panel for deep investigation of failed requests across dimensions (model variant, rollout stage, region, user cohort). The Fault Forest Navigator groups related failures into a navigable tree, surfaces a ranked list of root-cause hypotheses, and provides side-by-side payload diffs and retry-history without leaving the page. Goal is to reduce mean-time-to-diagnose for production errors by combining taxonomy, visual diffs, and guided retry exploration.
goals: Enable engineers and SREs to cluster and browse error families quickly
Expose retry histories and per-retry payloads with timeline scrubber
Surface likely root causes via lightweight heuristics (schema drift, kv-cache miss, variant mismatch)
Show cost-per-retry and incremental token cost impact inline
Integrate with rollouts so PMs can see which canary cohorts triggered the failures
user_flows: Open a failed-requests alert -> Fault Forest opens with focused forest view of related failures
Select a node (failure family) -> right pane shows representative request, payload diff to baseline, stack/context, and retry history
Use the timeline scrubber to step through retries; each scrub reveals the KV cache snapshot and model variant used
Mark a hypothesis as investigated -> auto-populate suggested follow-ups (create PR, block rollout cohort, add prompt constraint)
Export a triage snapshot (JSON) for on-call handoff
decisions: 2026-03-03: Chose tree+list hybrid over full graph to keep cognitive load low for on-call engineers
2026-03-05: Prototype will show a single representative request per cluster by default, with an explicit 'samples' dropdown to examine more
2026-03-07: Added cost-per-retry micro-metrics after eng asked for unit-economics for rollback decisions
2026-03-10: Decided to defer full replay capability; initial MVP will show replay intent + link to Request Replay service
review_feedback: PM (Lena Park): prefer clear CTA for 'Block cohort' when a hypothesis is high-confidence
Eng (Priya Nair): need explicit signal for KV cache staleness and ability to view KV key snapshots
SRE (Evan Zhou): timeline scrubber should support jump-to-error and show server-side logs inline
Design (Rohit Mehta): reduce color palette for failure severity to prevent alarm fatigue
acceptance_criteria: Forest view clusters failures by taxonomy and supports filtering by model variant, region, release tag
Representative request panel shows side-by-side payload diff (baseline vs failing) with highlighted token/field deltas
Retry timeline scrubber reveals per-retry metadata: timestamp, latency, model variant, KV-cache-hit/miss flag
Cost-per-retry line item is present and computed from token counts and model price profile
All interactions have keyboard accessibility and basic screen-reader labels
notes: Prototype uses synthetic failing requests from staging dataset 'fail-forest-v1' for usability testing
We will run two 1-hour sessions with on-call SREs and two product engineers to validate discovery heuristics
Follow-up: add drilldown for policy-triggered retries (exponential backoff) in a subsequent sprint
